description: A rotary knob for one parameter: drag, wheel, keys, a log scale, a reset, and the change's source for an agent. Its svelte adapter.

files.content:
<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
let { d, strokeWidth }: { d: string | null; strokeWidth: number } = $props();
</script>

{#if d}
  <path
    {d}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-width={strokeWidth}
  />
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import { DEFAULT_ARC_STROKE_WIDTH } from "../../../../audio-ui/core/primitives/knob/index";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import Arc from "./Arc.svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

let {
  strokeWidth,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Indicator>, "children" | "strokeWidth"> & {
  strokeWidth?: number;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Indicator {...rest} {strokeWidth}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <Arc d={state.arc} strokeWidth={strokeWidth ?? DEFAULT_ARC_STROKE_WIDTH} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Indicator>

<script lang="ts">
import { type Snippet, setContext } from "svelte";
import { DEFAULTS, type Defaults } from "./parts";

let { children, dragMode }: Defaults & { children: Snippet } = $props();
// Read as the knobs render, so a change of the prop reaches them.
setContext<Defaults>(DEFAULTS, {
  get dragMode() {
    return dragMode;
  },
});
</script>

{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
import { getContext } from "svelte";
import { DEFAULTS, type Defaults, parts } from "./parts";

let props = $props();
const defaults = getContext<Defaults | undefined>(DEFAULTS) ?? {};
</script>

<parts.Root {...props} dragMode={props.dragMode ?? defaults.dragMode} />

<script lang="ts">
import type { KnobPublicState } from "../../../../audio-ui/primitives/knob/index";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

/** The thumb, with the native input that carries the knob's name inside it. */
let {
  "aria-label": label,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Thumb>, "aria-label" | "children"> & {
  "aria-label"?: string;
  children?: Snippet<[KnobPublicState]>;
  getAriaValueText?: (formatted: string, value: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Thumb {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {@render content?.(state)}
    <parts.Input aria-label={label} {getAriaValueText} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Thumb>

<script lang="ts">
import { DEFAULT_ARC_STROKE_WIDTH } from "../../../../audio-ui/core/primitives/knob/index";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import Arc from "./Arc.svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

let {
  strokeWidth,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Track>, "children" | "strokeWidth"> & {
  strokeWidth?: number;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Track {...rest} {strokeWidth}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <Arc d={state.arc} strokeWidth={strokeWidth ?? DEFAULT_ARC_STROKE_WIDTH} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Track>

<script lang="ts">
import type { KnobPublicState } from "../../../../audio-ui/primitives/knob/index";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

let {
  children: content,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Value>, "children"> & {
  children?: Snippet<[KnobPublicState]>;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Value {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {#if content}
      {@render content(state)}
    {:else}
      {state.formatted}
    {/if}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Value>
